_doc: Naming rules for i18n keys and fragment files (tests/i18n_names.rs, tools/i18n/rename_keys.py). id_pattern: a first key segment or a file-name part (split at - and _) that is a work id: one letter, or any digit except a word ending in 3d (written without look-around, which the test regex engine lacks). deep_id_pattern: a work id inside a later key segment. id_ok: words the patterns would catch that are not ids. product_sha256: SHA-256 of lowercase product names beyond tools/name_lint/terms.txt. allow_*: names awaiting rename, each with its reason; the lists only shrink.

reasons.A: work-id key prefix, renamed through tools/i18n/key_renames.tsv
reasons.F: work-id file name, renamed through tools/i18n/key_renames.tsv
